## What it does

Scripts that keep continuous USGS discharge records current, classify storm events across monitoring sites, and map watershed rainfall and stream networks.

## Highlights

- USGS continuous-flow updates with dataRetrieval
- Hydrologic event classification with hydroEvents across multiple sites
- MRMS radar rainfall grids for the North Bosque watershed
- Watershed maps built on NHDPlus flowlines
